headline: The LPG Plant Manager directs pressurized liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) bottling and bulk distribution operations, governing high-speed electronic carousel filling precision, statutory cylinder recertification, and plant-wide process safety across extreme flammable hazard envelopes. While carousel automation systems like MAKEEN Energy (Kosan Crisplant) System Manager, bulk inventory software like Emerson Rosemount TankMaster, and enterprise ERP suites like SAP S/4HANA Secondary Distribution record gross fill numbers and schedule bulk tanker dispatches, they operate in operational silos without closed-loop diagnostic intelligence. Operating a commercial LPG bottling plant involves receiving 500 to 1,500 metric tons of pressurized propane/butane mixtures daily via road tankers or pipelines, storing them in mounded bullets at 10 to 15 bar, and filling 20,000 to 60,000 domestic and commercial cylinders per day across high-speed rotary carousels. Plant managers are overwhelmed by critical administrative and analytical friction: manually reconciling daily multi-source mass balances across custody meters, tank gauges, filling carousels, and vapor recovery compressors; hand-sorting check-weigher reject logs to identify which of 72 rotating filling heads has suffered pneumatic clamp drift or load-cell tare offset; and compiling multi-binder statutory compliance dossiers for periodic hydrostatic cylinder testing (DPT) under strict national pressure vessel regulations. Deploying a dedicated 7-agent hyper-specialized operational squad saves 30.00 hours per major operational and statutory cycle, eliminating undetected hydrocarbon losses, preventing overfilled cylinder distribution, and assuring 100% statutory recertification compliance.

role.oneLine: Directs pressurized LPG bottling plant operations, overseeing high-speed carousel filling precision, automated leak detection, statutory cylinder recertification, and process safety barriers to ensure zero-incident, legally compliant, and on-spec fuel packaging and distribution.
role.whyItMatters: In an LPG bottling plant, the consequences of operational failure are catastrophic. LPG is stored as a liquid under high pressure (typically 7 to 15 bar) and readily flashes into vapor upon release, expanding 250 to 270 times in volume to create dense, ground-hugging explosive clouds. A failure in carousel filling cutoff precision that distributes an overfilled cylinder into residential consumers' homes creates an imminent boiling liquid expanding vapor explosion (BLEVE) or catastrophic domestic fire if thermal liquid expansion breaches the pressure relief valve. Conversely, unrecorded tare-weight drift leads to severe commercial giveaway or statutory consumer protection violations. Furthermore, any undetected leak at bulk unloading gantries or mounded storage bullets exposes the facility to unconfined vapor cloud explosions (UVCE).

agents.name: Bulk Receipt & Carousel Mass Balance Reconciliation Sieve
agents.oneLine: Ingests weighbridge custody tickets, Coriolis mass flowmeter streams, mounded bullet radar level data, and rotary carousel gross fill totals to assemble a continuous closed-loop plant mass balance and detect unrecorded inventory losses.
agents.frictionSolved: Eliminates 3.50 hours daily of tedious multi-spreadsheet reconciliation, manual density-temperature corrections, and elusive inventory variance hunting across 1,000+ tons of daily throughput.
agents.reads: Road tanker weighbridge gross/tare weigh slips, Coriolis pipeline receipt mass flow logs, mounded storage bullet level and density data from tank gauging systems, rotary carousel cumulative gross fill weights, and vapor recovery compressor suction records.
agents.does: 1. Reconciles raw bulk liquid receipts against refinery/terminal dispatch manifests, converting volumes to mass using ASTM Table 54/24 temperature and density correction algorithms; 2. Aggregates filled cylinder weights across all carousel operating shifts, deducting certified tare weights to compute total bottled liquid mass; 3. Calculates vapor recovery compressor displacement and accounts for cylinder degassing returns; 4. Computes facility-wide mass balance equation: Mass Balance Error = (Opening Inventory + Bulk Receipts) - (Bottled Mass Dispatched + Vapor Returned + Closing Inventory); 5. Flags statistical mass variances exceeding statutory allowable tolerance thresholds (typically ±0.15%).
agents.returns: Daily Certified Plant Mass Balance Dossier displaying unit-by-unit reconciliation, meter variance flags, and physical loss risk indicators.
agents.stopsAt: Authorizing commercial financial loss write-offs or modifying custody transfer billing figures.
agents.failureModes: If daily unaccounted mass loss exceeds 0.25% of total throughput or a sudden negative mass step is detected while storage levels drop, the agent issues an emergency [Process Safety Alarm: Potential Underground Pipe Leak or Unmetered Vapor Release — Physical Verification Mandated].

agents.name: Rotary Carousel Filling Head Drift & Check-Weigher Defect Sieve
agents.oneLine: Correlates electronic carousel filling head load-cell logs with downstream check-weigher reject timestamps to pinpoint drifting filling heads and leaking shut-off valves before legal metrology tolerances or overfilling limits are breached.
agents.frictionSolved: Removes 3.10 hours per shift of manual check-weigher reject bin sorting, physical reference scale check-weighing, and trial-and-error carousel head isolation across 72 rotating heads.
agents.reads: Carousel electronic filling head weight curves, clamp engagement timestamps, check-weigher in-line gross weight logs, cylinder reject diversion signals, and static reference scale quality audit logs.
agents.does: 1. Maps each check-weigher reject timestamp back to the exact carousel filling head index that processed the container; 2. Analyzes net fill weight distributions per filling head across rolling 50-cylinder batches to detect creeping calibration drift; 3. Detects pneumatic clamp leakage: identifies heads with delayed cutoff or slow shut-off valve seat closure causing overfills; 4. Detects tare-weight deduction errors: flags instances where dirty or worn tare sensors failed to tare empty cylinders; 5. Generates targeted maintenance recommendations specifying mechanical valve replacement or load-cell recalibration.
agents.returns: Carousel Filling Head Health Matrix displaying per-head mean deviation, standard deviation, reject percentages, and specific head isolation warnings.
agents.stopsAt: Automatically locking out physical carousel filling heads without operator maintenance confirmation.
agents.failureModes: If any single filling head dispenses two consecutive cylinders exceeding statutory maximum gross weight (+150 grams on a 14.2 kg container), the agent marks [Critical Overfill Breach: Immediate Head Isolation Mandated].

agents.name: Automated Leak Detection & Valve Seal Defect Diagnostic Sieve
agents.oneLine: Ingests submerged water-bath optical bubble detection video streams, electronic sniffer PPM hydrocarbon logs, and cylinder serial tags to isolate recurring valve gland leaks, defective internal O-rings, and bung micro-cracks before dispatch.
agents.frictionSolved: Eliminates 3.05 hours daily of manual reject bin verification, electronic sniffer recalibration hunting, and dangerous undetected cylinder valve seal weepage.
agents.reads: In-line water bath high-definition camera bubble recognition feeds, multi-head electronic sniffer infrared absorption PPM traces, conveyor line speeds, and reject pusher gate actuation logs.
agents.does: 1. Distinguishes genuine escaping hydrocarbon bubbles from surface aeration or conveyor carryover water; 2. Correlates sniffer gas concentration peaks with cylinder valve collar positions, isolating whether the leak originates at the spindle gland, the internal rubber O-ring seal, or the neck bung weld; 3. Tracks recurring leak patterns by cylinder manufacturer vintage or valve lot to detect defective valve batches; 4. Quantifies leak severity and routes cylinders into appropriate safe paths (immediate evacuation bay vs. cold valve-replacement workshop); 5. Audits sniffer sensor zero-point drift and cleanliness against ambient hydrocarbon baselines.
agents.returns: Daily Cylinder Leak & Valve Defect Triage Dossier categorizing defects, pinpointing bad valve batches, and certifying 100% leak testing compliance.
agents.stopsAt: Authorizing physical hot-work repairs or clearing un-evacuated leaking cylinders for storage.
agents.failureModes: If electronic sniffer concentration exceeds 2,500 ppm at the carousel exit conveyor, the agent triggers an immediate [Severe Fugitive Gas Release: Conveyor Stop & Evacuation Bay Transfer Required].

agents.name: Statutory Cylinder Due-for-Testing (DPT) & Degassing Campaign Formulator
agents.oneLine: Ingests optical character recognition (OCR) stay-plate stamp readings, tare-weight checks, and cylinder fleet databases to formulate statutory 5- and 10-year periodic retesting (DPT) batches and track evacuation/degassing compliance per statutory pressure vessel rules.
agents.frictionSolved: Eliminates 5.75 hours per batch campaign of manual cylinder collar stamp deciphering, paper degassing log tracking, and test scheduling errors across thousands of mixed-vintage containers.
agents.reads: High-speed OCR collar camera image feeds, cylinder serial numbers, original manufacturer test dates, tare weight stampings, and statutory retesting registries.
agents.does: 1. Deciphers weathered and paint-obscured collar stampings to determine original hydrostatic test dates and last inspection quarters; 2. Identifies cylinders due for periodic testing (DPT) under statutory rules (first test at 10 years, subsequent tests every 5 years); 3. Formulates optimized retesting campaigns grouped by manufacturer, design code (e.g., IS 3196 / ISO 4706), and water capacity; 4. Tracks mandatory pre-test safety protocols: validates complete evacuation of residual LPG liquid, vacuum depressurization, and complete water displacement degassing; 5. Flags lost or non-compliant containers for physical decommissioning or statutory scrapping.
agents.returns: Statutory Cylinder Retest Batch Campaign Package and Evacuation Clearance Dossier ready for hydrotest shop staging.
agents.stopsAt: Overriding statutory condemnation criteria or approving un-degassed cylinders for workshop valve removal.
agents.failureModes: If a cylinder scheduled for valve removal lacks verified electronic evacuation and water degassing confirmation, the agent locks the workflow as [Un-Evacuated Vessel: Valve Removal Strictly Prohibited — Flash Fire Hazard].

agents.name: Hydrostatic Stretch Testing & Tare-Weight Recertification Auditor
agents.oneLine: Ingests automated water-jacket hydrostatic test pressure-expansion curves, permanent volumetric expansion ratios (below 10%), and post-shotblast tare-weight measurements to certify cylinder pressure integrity or condemn structurally depleted vessels.
agents.frictionSolved: Eliminates 4.85 hours per test batch of manual burette water displacement reading, permanent expansion percentage math, and statutory certification filing paperwork across hundreds of tested cylinders.
agents.reads: Water-jacket hydrostatic test bench data (test pressure up to 2.5 MPa / 25 bar, total volumetric expansion, permanent volumetric expansion), post-shotblast empty tare scale readings, and cylinder original design wall thickness registers.
agents.does: 1. Evaluates pressure-hold curves against statutory proof standards: confirms minimum 30-second hold at 2.5 MPa with zero pressure drop; 2. Computes permanent volumetric expansion ratio: Permanent Expansion Ratio = fracPermanent ExpansionTotal Expansion ×100%; 3. Enforces statutory pass/fail thresholds: automatically condemns any cylinder with permanent expansion exceeding 10% or any visible weld weeping; 4. Evaluates tare-weight reduction against original stamped tare: flags cylinders with >5% tare weight loss due to corrosion for mandatory condemnation; 5. Formulates statutory recertification inspection certificates and populates new tare weight and test quarter stamping schedules.
agents.returns: Certified Statutory Cylinder Hydrostatic Recertification Dossier, Condemned Cylinder Scrapping Ledger, and New Stamping Worksheets.
agents.stopsAt: Authorizing physical scrapping destruction or signing official statutory test certificates without the certified Competent Person's digital signature.
agents.failureModes: If a cylinder exceeds the 10% permanent expansion limit or shows an instantaneous pressure decay during the 25 bar hold, the agent locks the serial number as [Vessel Condemned: Hydrostatic Failure — Immediate Physical Crushing Required].

negativeSearch.result: Negative Search, 2026-09. Commercial carousel software logs individual fill weights and marks check-weigher rejects; none autonomously run multi-head statistical variance and signature correlation to diagnose specific pneumatic clamp or cutoff valve wear patterns across 72 filling heads without manual maintenance triage.

line: "In an LPG bottling plant, you are handling thousands of tons of high-pressure propane and butane at fifteen bar while filling forty thousand domestic cylinders a day. An error of fifty grams across a million cylinders is fifty tons of lost product, but an overfilled cylinder or an undetected valve seal leak inside someone's home isn't an inventory variance—it's a catastrophic vapor-cloud explosion waiting for a spark."
